description: This file defines a tool for controlling and interacting with HTML canvas elements within a node-based environment. It includes functions for actions like present, hide, navigate, evaluate JavaScript, take snapshots, and push or reset UI data, with schema validation and external integrations.

methods.name: readJsonlFromPath
methods.description: Reads a JSONL file from a specified path after validating path permissions and resolving the real path.

methods.name: createCanvasTool
methods.description: Factory function that creates a tool object for controlling canvas elements, supporting actions like present, hide, navigate, eval, snapshot, and UI push/reset.
